name: Bookme Widget
author: devbookme

sections.description: The Bookme Widget Plugin allows you to embed the Bookme service directly on your WordPress website as an iframe. This lets your customers easily browse and book services without leaving your site. Easily connect your Bookme account and customize which professionals and languages are available for booking through the plugin settings. The widget is fully responsive and appears as a fixed element on the page, ensuring easy access for users across all devices.
sections.installation:
1. Install the Plugin

    • Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress Admin Dashboard.
    • Search for “Bookme Widget.”
    • Click Install Now, then Activate the plugin.

  2. Set Up the Plugin

    • Go to Bookme Widget in your WordPress admin menu.
    • Log in with your Bookme account (or use Google login).
    • After logging in, select your Professional (if needed).
    • Choose your preferred language for the widget display.
    • Click Save Settings to enable the widget on your website.

The widget will now appear on all pages, allowing customers to book services directly from your website.
